  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong documentation, report-writing and presentation skills

  • Experience with cloud accounting platforms, particularly Xero
  • Familiarity with financial services, accounting or professional services environments

  • Exposure to machine learning, AI-assisted tools or data-driven business process automation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver projects ahead of schedule and within budget
